summary_1line: After Abhimanyu’s death, the grieving Yudhishthira questions the nature of Death, and Vyasa begins recounting an ancient tale about its origin.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira sits in grief on the battlefield while the sage Vyasa arrives and speaks words of consolation.
Young Abhimanyu stands surrounded by many enemy chariot-warriors before being overwhelmed in unequal combat.
King Akampana mourns beside the funeral rites of his fallen son Hari while the celestial sage Narada approaches.
